# EnTT provenance

This directory vendors the unmodified EnTT v3.15.0 single-include header and
license from commit `d4014c74dc3793aba95ae354d6e23a026c2796db`:

- source: <https://github.com/skypjack/entt>
- `single_include/entt/entt.hpp` SHA-256:
  `155d4a180f76a0efd61b873e21940d782e7f5bb8dcf5fdf02a1721e452de1f63`
- `LICENSE` SHA-256:
  `0785027ce472d7c61f05fba664a1d3ba6639c1593ced351ad9e4bed868765d99`

The header is private component storage for the deterministic simulation. Public
simulation IDs are independent nonzero `uint64_t` values, never EnTT handles.
